name: Ta Phin
summary: Village walk north of town: see the houses and terraces in daylight without a guide, the other short trip. An older loop runs from town through Ta Phin, Móng Sến, and Tắc Cô. Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào is 40,000 đồng for an adult and 20,000 đồng for a child. Read the gate. The 2025 xã Tả Phìn merged Trung Chải with Tả Phìn.
getThere: North of town on the Ta Phin loop.
heroCaption: Houses, the path, and terraces at Ta Phin
body: Walk the houses, the path, and the terraces under the peak. You can see Ta Phin, like Cat Cat, without a guide. An older route is town, Tả Phìn, Móng Sến, Tắc Cô, and back to town.

Thôn Tả Phìn also sits in xã Tả Van. The 2025 xã Tả Phìn is the merger of xã Trung Chải and xã Tả Phìn. Keep those two names apart when you ask the way. Tả Phìn–Sín Chải–Hầu Thào is 40,000 đồng for an adult and 20,000 đồng for a child. Read the gate.
